Process units
=============

+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------------------+
| Category             | Models               | Purpose                          |
+======================+======================+==================================+
| Pretreatment         | UF, MF               | Particle and suspended solids    |
+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------------------+
| Pressure membranes   | NF, RO               | Ion removal and desalination     |
+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------------------+
| Thermal membranes    | MD                   | Brine concentration/desalination |
+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------------------+
| Support units        | Pump, energy recovery| Pressure and energy accounting   |
+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------------------+
| Biological membrane  | MBR, DMBR            | Reuse/wastewater treatment       |
+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------------------+
